git diff --cached --name-only -z | python3 -c 'import sys,pathlib,re
hits=[]
for x in sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b"\0"):
 if not x:continue
 p=pathlib.Path(x.decode())
 if not p.is_file():continue
 try:s=p.read_text()
 except:continue
 if re.search(r"(?i)(?:authorization[\"\x27]?\s*[:=]\s*[\"\x27]Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{20,}|(?:api[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret|password)[\"\x27]?\s*[:=]\s*[\"\x27][A-Za-z0-9_+-]{24,})",s):hits.append(str(p))
print("Potential credential assignment files:",len(hits))
print("\n".join(hits[:25]))'
